result:
The two tools are live at `POST /mcp`, and `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (11 tests), and `bunx guren gate` all pass. `bunx guren check` reports 0 failures and 4 warnings, all about controllers without a test file. `bunx guren tool:list` shows exactly `posts_search` (read-only) and `posts_store` (not read-only).

One behaviour change to be aware of: `POST /posts` now answers a JSON caller (`Accept: application/json`, no `X-Inertia`) with the created post and status 201 instead of a redirect. The Inertia "New post" form still gets its 303 to the new post, and a test covers that. I did this because the gate fails a tool that advertises no output shape, and a tool call cannot follow a redirect.

A guest calling `posts_store` gets the same redirect to `/login` the web form gives, and nothing is created.

I also added an ADR recording the decision, which you didn't ask for.

**Summary:** I installed `@guren/plugin-mcp` (`package.json`, `bun.lock`) and registered `mcpPlugin()` plus `EventServiceProvider` in `src/app.ts`. I added an `api_tokens` table to `db/schema.ts` with its migration in `db/migrations/20260929172656_create_api_tokens/`, and configured `auth.useTokens(new DatabaseApiTokenStore(apiTokens), { provider: 'users' })` in `app/Providers/AuthProvider.ts` so a bearer resolves to the real user record. In `routes/web.ts` I declared `agent` metadata on the existing `posts.search` and `posts.store` routes with the tool names `posts_search` and `posts_store`, plus a `resource` hint on `posts.store`. `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` now returns the created post as JSON to JSON callers while keeping the form's redirect. I regenerated `.guren/` (new `agents.gen.ts`, updated `api-client.gen.ts`), added `tests/McpEndpoint.test.ts` covering the contract (401 without a credential, tool listing and flags, search parity, author enforcement, 422, guest refusal), and wrote `docs/adr/0002-serve-post-search-and-drafting-to-assistants-over-mcp.md`.
